name: Katherine Lowe
life: “I repaired a stuck hospital lift on the morning my daughter was born upstairs.” Thursday often includes a stop at the brick passage off the shop row, where Katherine takes the longer way when the smell from the ovens reaches the pavement.
voice: I found the other mitten in the lift. I've put the pair on a cord long enough to cover two chairs.
appearance: Katherine is easy to recognize by a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape and a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth. Usually dressed in a dark green knitted vest with a thin silver ring worn on a cord, Katherine starts to lift a hand, then waits to be invited to speak when listening.
personality: Katherine thinks best while walking. Sitting beneath someone's office clock makes Katherine sound more certain than they feel, an effect close friends have learned to distrust.
agenda: To put the two mittens on a cord long enough to share.
family: Noel Holmes is Katherine’s older cousin. Katherine remembers the birthdays. Noel asks what the birthday guest would like this year. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *The spare spectacles*, Noel says, “I sat beside her because my own witness statement had cost me a friend.”
connections: Allen Marin. They reunite the pair and choose the cord between them.

reactions.situation: A patient wants the chair kept empty for a while
reactions.response: Katherine saves the chair for a short agreed interval and checks who else needs it.
